# Housing instructions must agree with marked assignment

Apply this user-authorized precedence to every existing, legacy, locked and future card: when marked workable property includes apartments, condominiums, townhomes, mobile homes or any other residence, replace conflicting legacy housing exclusions in the printed instructions. Record the user decision; do not request repeated clarification for this already authorized resolution. Preserve colors, inside-only sides, explicit map exclusions and assignment/access restrictions. Never expand outside assigned work or into another territory. A housing type alone is not an exclusion basis. Distinguish a workable approach road from a complex assigned elsewhere; verify that assignment/access evidence.

Require top-level `housing_instruction_review` in builder projects and critic reports. Use the schema in the builder and `validate_housing_instructions.py` in both gates:

- `rule_precedence`: `marked_assignment_over_legacy_housing_exclusions`; `user_decision`: ISO `date`, exact applicable `instruction`, durable conversation/decision `source_ref`.
- `assignment_source_ref`, `assignment_source_sha256`: original coverage authority; hash must match `coverage_review.source_sha256`.
- `assigned_housing`: one group per verified `housing_type`, `assignment_evidence` identifying housing type and marked scope, and `feature_refs` of `{source_id,feature_id}`. Cover exactly all inventory properties with eligibility `eligible` and disposition `matched` or `verified_addition`. Supported types: `single_family_homes`, `apartments`, `condominiums`, `townhomes`, `mobile_homes`, `other_residential`. Do not guess housing types from street names.
- `excluded_property_review`: groups of `basis`, `evidence`, `feature_refs` retaining every inventory property with eligibility `ineligible`, exactly once. Basis must be `map_exclusion`, `outside_assignment`, `inside_only_other_side`, `assigned_other_territory`, `access_rule`, or `nonresidential`. The evidence must establish the actual assignment/access reason; relabeling an obsolete apartment exclusion as an access rule is invalid.
- Unique `included_housing_types`, `legacy_housing_exclusions`; `legacy_instruction_evidence` retaining prior text and review source even when no conflict exists.
- `resolutions`: exactly one per assigned type that legacy instructions exclude. Include `housing_type`, `previous_instruction`, exact printed `revised_instruction`, `assignment_evidence`, `decision_ref`. The revised phrase must appear in actual final text and include that housing type or all assigned residences. An old houses-only instruction can remain only after the complete inventory establishes houses are the only assigned housing type.
- `rendered_instructions_text`: all text extracted from the actual final PDF, including any work note outside the directions sidebar. Gates compare normalized full text where the PDF exists and reject explicit conflicting exclusions. Do not quote obsolete restrictions on the delivered card.
- `unresolved_conflicts: []`; `assignment_scope_preserved`, `work_colors_preserved`, `inside_only_sides_preserved`, `map_exclusions_preserved`, `instructions_review_completed`: all true, with concrete `evidence` of map-versus-print review in both directions. Inclusion must remain limited to actual assignment, preserving every exclusion, inside-only side and other-territory boundary.

Read the actual map and all printed instructions independently. Keyword checks catch explicit denials; evidence and independent semantic review are also mandatory for paraphrases or implicit conflicts. Missing evidence, unresolved map/instruction disagreement, housing-only exclusions of assigned residences, or instruction scope expansion is a hard failure. The critic caps at 8 and release is false. The target remains 10 and release threshold is exactly 10 in every category with no critical failures.
